messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Ingress layer anomaly detected — sudden rise in 5xx (502/504) from edge POPs serving us-east region. p50 latency +120ms, error-rate spike started ~T-3m. Paging eng_oncall :pager:
eng_oncall: ack @incident-bot :pager: I'm on it, joining now
alice.m: seeing it in telemetry too — /v1/generate error rate jumped to ~11% in last 2m (was ~0.4%). Spike concentrated on long-tail requests (>1.5s).
ben.prod: customer-impact signal: three enterprise tenants reported failing webhooks and client timeouts, one support ticket opened. Marking potential customer-impacting incident.
carol-sre: running a quick curl loop against apigw in us-east, results interleaved 200/502:
```bash
for i in {1..6}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.edge-us-east.example/v1/generate; done
# sample output
502 0.11
200 0.30
502 0.09
200 0.28
502 0.12
```
carol-sre: investigating proxy logs — seeing upstream connection failures and timeouts from envoy/haproxy layer: "upstream reset" and "connection failure" to backend pools.
carol-sre: snippet from edge proxy log:
```
[2026-03-15T10:02:11Z] proxy[envoy]: upstream reset: reason=CONNECT_FAIL host=10.45.12.33:8080 route=/v1/generate
[2026-03-15T10:02:12Z] proxy[envoy]: downstream response code: 502, x-request-id=abc-123
```
eng_oncall: checklist from runbook: 1) confirm hitmap (regions/pops) 2) check upstream pool health 3) try rolling restart of ingress pods 4) add temporary routing fallback -> low-risk pool. Doing region hitmap now.
alice.m: hitmap shows elevated errors only in us-east-1a and us-east-1b edge POPs, us-east-2 and eu unaffected. Backends behind those POPs show increased TCP resets.
ben.prod: will prepare status update. Draft: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting requests routed via our us-east edge POPs. Mitigation in progress." Need ETA once we have first mitigation result.
darren-support: collecting customer examples, please post request IDs and sample timestamps to that channel. I'll triage tickets.
carol-sre: quick mitigation option: shift traffic for affected POPs to warm standby pool (us-east-2) via control-plane command. Propose temporary routing rule to reduce immediate customer impact. Anyone object?
eng_oncall: agree, prefer traffic shift + rolling restart of apigw-ingress in the two affected clusters to reclaim healthy upstream connections. Execute shift first, then restart.
carol-sre: executing routing change now: `redwoodctl traffic-route set --pop=us-east-1a,us-east-1b --fallback=us-east-warm-standby --percent=70`
ops-bot: command accepted, applying policy. Change id: rc-20260315-01. Monitoring for impact.
carol-sre: starting rolling restart of ingress deployment in us-east-1a: `kubectl -n edge-us-east-1 rollout restart deployment apigw-ingress`
carol-sre: after route shift + restart, initial telemetry shows error-rate dropping from 11% -> 2.2% within 90s. p50 latency also returning to baseline.
eng_oncall: good. keeping extra watchers on logs for any regression. Leave temporary route change in place until we have root cause.
alice.m: root-cause traces show spike correlates with a surge of long-connection requests that exhaust upstream connection pool (keepalive exhaustion). Backend pool reported connection refusals.
ben.prod: status update ready: "Mitigation in progress: traffic partially routed to standby region and ingress restart started. Errors decreased after mitigation. Investigating root cause — will update in 30m." Post to status page?
darren-support: please include list of impacted tenants (ids attached offline), also set interim communication to priority customers.
carol-sre: next steps: 1) add more upstream backends to pool (scaling), 2) review keepalive/conn limits, 3) perform postmortem and add improved autoscale for connection-starvation scenarios.
eng_oncall: will monitor for 15m. If stable, we'll de-escalate severity after 30m and open a P1 follow-up for RCA. Handing to oncall shadow for overnight watch in 40m.
incident-bot: Incident created: P1-3516000000, link: https://incidents.redwood.example/P1-3516000000 (priority: high, sla impact: high).
ben.prod: posted status update to status.redwood.example and notified account execs.
darren-support: collecting repro examples and will attach to incident.
alice.m: saving logs and traces to incident ticket.
eng_oncall: closing live triage for now — mitigation effective, continuing monitoring and RCA work. :white_check_mark:
